intro.text: The hands-on engineer of a team of scholars from the Institute of Mechanical Solutions, who bring a machine to Gongsha to summon spirits.
A Torish scholar of the Institute of Mechanical Solutions, one of those who switched on the father machine, which keeps Yumi prisoner.

items.text: He was among the scholars who designed and switched on the father machine. It consumed them, but held his soul in reserve to defend itself, though he still became a nightmare. When Yumi's mind began resisting the machine's tampering, he was one of four scholars sent under Gyundok's lead to Gongsha Town to look into it.

When the scholars' prototype would not run, Sunjun spent days on it and traced the fault to the power source, then flatly refused Gyundok's order to prime it himself. As the machine started, he saw that it drew on an extra source; he warned that a spirit was near and used a detection device to track Yumi until she got away.

When Nikaro and Yumi came to destroy the prototype, Gyundok told Sunjun it was time for the confrontation, and Sunjun switched on the boxy device that severed Yumi's Connection to Nikaro. Like the other scholars, he was a nightmare.

After Yumi and Nikaro were separated, he and the other scholars worked to fix the trouble in Gongsha and keep Yumi contained. When she escaped, they chased her to Torio City, where the force of her will made them stand down.

appearance.text: Sunjun has the bearded chin and mustache typical of Torish scholars, and dresses in white with a black, winged tanggeon.

personality.text: The most engineering-minded of the scholars, Sunjun likes to work hands-on with their equipment, and he is the most observant of them.
